title: ParkourNoMods{PNM}
body:
This mod adds the ability to climb walls (blocks, chains, and fences) up to 4 blocks high, crawl through holes without using a hatch, cling to half-blocks in walls, and slide smoothly down walls. You'll also gain a variable stamina of 30 units, which will be consumed and restored.

TG:https://t.me/Logovo_x_fredyy
